name: JoAi: Create Campaign

description.en: Create a marketing campaign via email, WhatsApp, SMS, or push. Target a saved segment, tags, specific contacts, or (for push) specific app installs. Draft only — use Send Campaign to deliver or schedule.
description.de: Erstelle eine Marketing-Kampagne per E-Mail, WhatsApp, SMS oder Push. Zielgruppe: Segment, Tags, bestimmte Kontakte oder (bei Push) bestimmte App-Installationen. Nur Entwurf — Versand/Planung über Kampagne senden.
description.fr: Créez une campagne marketing par e-mail, WhatsApp, SMS ou push. Ciblez un segment, des tags, des contacts, ou (pour le push) des installations d'app. Brouillon uniquement — utilisez Envoyer la campagne pour livrer ou planifier.
description.es: Crea una campaña de marketing por email, WhatsApp, SMS o push. Dirígete a un segmento, etiquetas, contactos o (para push) instalaciones de app. Solo borrador — usa Enviar campaña para entregar o programar.
description.it: Crea una campagna di marketing via email, WhatsApp, SMS o push. Destinatari: segmento, tag, contatti o (per push) installazioni app. Solo bozza — usa Invia campagna per inviare o programmare.
description.ro: Creează o campanie de marketing prin email, WhatsApp, SMS sau push. Țintește un segment, taguri, contacte sau (pentru push) instalări de app. Doar schiță — folosește Trimite campanie pentru livrare sau programare.

bot: Use when creating a campaign. Collect channel, content, and audience. For push: omit audience to target all subscribed installs, or pass segmentId / installIds / contactIds (contacts resolve to their installs). List installs first if picking devices. Prefer segmentId for reusable push audiences (e.g. has_install + install_push_status subscribed). If content uses {{placeholders}}, set templateParams and/or aiParams. For WhatsApp set language and category. For HTML email set contentHtml=true and pass the full HTML as content.

description.es: Asunto del correo (solo canal de correo)

inputs.name: Content HTML

description.en: Email only: treat content as HTML instead of plain text
description.de: Nur E-Mail: Inhalt als HTML statt als Klartext behandeln
description.fr: E-mail uniquement : traiter le contenu comme HTML au lieu de texte brut
description.es: Solo correo: tratar el contenido como HTML en lugar de texto plano
description.it: Solo email: trattare il contenuto come HTML anziché testo semplice
description.ro: Doar email: tratează conținutul ca HTML în loc de text simplu

inputs.bot: Set true for email when content is a full HTML document (tables, inline styles). Omit for plain text. The unsubscribe link is appended automatically.

description.en: Tags — target contacts with any of these
description.de: Tags — Kontakte mit einem dieser Tags ansprechen
description.fr: Tags — cibler les contacts avec l'un de ces tags
description.es: Etiquetas — dirigirse a contactos con cualquiera de estas
description.it: Tag — contattare chi ha uno di questi tag
description.ro: Taguri — țintește contactele cu oricare dintre acestea

description.fr: Hashids de contacts spécifiques à cibler
description.es: Hashids de contactos específicos a los que dirigirse
description.it: Hashid di contatti specifici da contattare
description.ro: Hashid-uri de contacte specifice de țintit

inputs.name: Segment ID
inputs.bot: Preferred for reusable audiences. For push install audiences use conditions like [{"type":"has_install","value":true},{"type":"install_push_status","value":"subscribed"}]. When set, tags/contactIds/installIds are ignored.

inputs.name: Install IDs

description.en: Push only: specific install hashids (devices) to target
description.de: Nur Push: bestimmte Installations-Hashids (Geräte) als Zielgruppe
description.fr: Push uniquement : hashids d'installations (appareils) à cibler
description.es: Solo push: hashids de instalaciones (dispositivos) a los que dirigirse
description.it: Solo push: hashid di installazioni (dispositivi) da contattare
description.ro: Doar push: hashid-uri de instalări (dispozitive) de țintit

inputs.bot: Use for push when targeting specific devices. Get IDs from List Installs. Ignored when segmentId is set. Omit with channel=push to target all subscribed installs.

inputs.name: Template params

description.en: Static placeholder values as JSON object. Keys match {{placeholders}} in content/subject. Values are literals or contact.* paths (e.g. {"name":"contact.name"}).
description.de: Statische Platzhalter-Werte als JSON-Objekt. Schlüssel entsprechen {{Platzhaltern}} in Inhalt/Betreff. Werte sind Literale oder contact.*-Pfade (z. B. {"name":"contact.name"}).
description.fr: Valeurs de placeholders statiques en objet JSON. Les clés correspondent aux {{placeholders}} du contenu/objet. Valeurs littérales ou chemins contact.* (ex. {"name":"contact.name"}).
description.es: Valores estáticos de placeholders como objeto JSON. Las claves coinciden con {{placeholders}} en contenido/asunto. Valores literales o rutas contact.* (p. ej. {"name":"contact.name"}).
description.it: Valori statici dei placeholder come oggetto JSON. Le chiavi corrispondono ai {{placeholders}} in contenuto/oggetto. Valori letterali o percorsi contact.* (es. {"name":"contact.name"}).
description.ro: Valori statice pentru placeholder ca obiect JSON. Cheile corespund {{placeholders}} din conținut/subiect. Valori literale sau căi contact.* (ex. {"name":"contact.name"}).

inputs.bot: Required whenever content/subject contains {{placeholders}} that should not be AI-filled. Pass a JSON object like {"name":"contact.name","city":"Vienna"}. Supported contact paths: contact.name, contact.email, contact.phone, contact.company, contact.title, contact.location. Do not leave placeholders unmapped.

inputs.name: AI params

description.en: AI placeholder prompts as JSON object. Keys match {{placeholders}}; values are prompts the sending agent fills per contact. Requires agentId. Not supported for WhatsApp.
description.de: KI-Platzhalter-Prompts als JSON-Objekt. Schlüssel entsprechen {{Platzhaltern}}; Werte sind Prompts, die der sendende Agent pro Kontakt füllt. Erfordert agentId. Nicht für WhatsApp.
description.fr: Prompts IA pour placeholders en objet JSON. Les clés correspondent aux {{placeholders}} ; les valeurs sont des prompts remplis par agent et contact. Nécessite agentId. Non pris en charge pour WhatsApp.
description.es: Prompts de IA para placeholders como objeto JSON. Las claves coinciden con {{placeholders}}; los valores son prompts que el agente rellena por contacto. Requiere agentId. No compatible con WhatsApp.
description.it: Prompt IA per placeholder come oggetto JSON. Le chiavi corrispondono ai {{placeholders}}; i valori sono prompt che l'agente riempie per contatto. Richiede agentId. Non supportato per WhatsApp.
description.ro: Prompturi AI pentru placeholder ca obiect JSON. Cheile corespund {{placeholders}}; valorile sunt prompturi pe care agentul le completează per contact. Necesită agentId. Nu e suportat pentru WhatsApp.

inputs.bot: Use for personalized AI-written slots, e.g. {"offer":"Mention a short local offer"}. Each key must appear as {{key}} in content/subject. Requires agentId. Do not use on WhatsApp. A placeholder must be in either templateParams or aiParams, not both.

inputs.name: Agent ID

description.en: Agent UUID used to fill AI placeholders (required when aiParams is set)
description.de: Agent-UUID zum Füllen der KI-Platzhalter (erforderlich bei aiParams)
description.fr: UUID de l'agent pour remplir les placeholders IA (requis si aiParams est défini)
description.es: UUID del agente para rellenar placeholders de IA (obligatorio si hay aiParams)
description.it: UUID dell'agente per riempire i placeholder IA (obbligatorio con aiParams)
description.ro: UUID-ul agentului pentru completarea placeholder-elor AI (obligatoriu când există aiParams)

inputs.bot: Pass the sending agent's UUID when aiParams is set. The agent must have an active integration for the campaign channel.

inputs.name: Language

description.en: Template language code for WhatsApp approval (e.g. de, en)
description.de: Vorlagen-Sprachcode für WhatsApp-Freigabe (z. B. de, en)
description.fr: Code langue du modèle pour l'approbation WhatsApp (ex. de, en)
description.es: Código de idioma de la plantilla para aprobación de WhatsApp (p. ej. de, en)
description.it: Codice lingua del template per l'approvazione WhatsApp (es. de, en)
description.ro: Codul de limbă al șablonului pentru aprobarea WhatsApp (ex. de, en)

inputs.bot: Required for WhatsApp template campaigns before submit-for-approval. Use a short locale like de or en.

inputs.name: Category

description.en: WhatsApp template category: MARKETING, UTILITY, or AUTHENTICATION
description.fr: Catégorie de modèle WhatsApp : MARKETING, UTILITY ou AUTHENTICATION
description.es: Categoría de plantilla de WhatsApp: MARKETING, UTILITY o AUTHENTICATION
description.it: Categoria template WhatsApp: MARKETING, UTILITY o AUTHENTICATION
description.ro: Categoria șablonului WhatsApp: MARKETING, UTILITY sau AUTHENTICATION

inputs.bot: Required for WhatsApp template campaigns. Usually MARKETING for promo messages.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.fr: Slug d'équipe pour cette action. Par défaut l'équipe actuelle.
description.es: Slug del equipo para esta acción. Por defecto el equipo actual.
description.it: Slug del team per questa azione. Predefinito: team attuale.
description.ro: Slug-ul echipei pentru această acțiune. Implicit echipa curentă.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.

success.de: Kampagne '{{CAMPAIGN_NAME}}' als Entwurf erstellt, Zielgruppe: {{CAMPAIGN_TOTAL}} Empfänger.
success.fr: Campagne « {{CAMPAIGN_NAME}} » créée comme brouillon ciblant {{CAMPAIGN_TOTAL}} destinataires.
success.es: Campaña « {{CAMPAIGN_NAME}} » creada como borrador con {{CAMPAIGN_TOTAL}} destinatarios.
success.it: Campagna « {{CAMPAIGN_NAME}} » creata come bozza con {{CAMPAIGN_TOTAL}} destinatari.
success.ro: Campania „{{CAMPAIGN_NAME}}” a fost creată ca schiță țintind {{CAMPAIGN_TOTAL}} destinatari.

error.fr: Échec de la création de la campagne : {{MESSAGE}}
